name: @feltcircle/server-node
description: FeltCircle authoritative multiplayer server for ordinary VPS hosting (Node.js + WebSocket + SQLite).

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/server.mjs --external:bufferutil --external:utf-8-validate --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
